Accepted English language Tests
Accepted English language Tests
Accepted English
Language Tests
The following English Language tests and requirements have been approved by the University for entry to postgraduate courses. These are the only tests that will be accepted by University of Warwick. If you have taken an alternative test that is not on the list below you will need to arrange to take one of the acceptable tests.
Some departments set specific department requirements - these are listed on each course page under entry requirements.
Please visit Pre-Sessional English language requirements if you are interested in using the Pre-sessional English language course to meet your English language condition.
Please provide your most recent English language test.
We have compiled a list of Approved English Language Tests for you to browse and check below.
If you have any questions, please contact our Postgraduate Admissions Team for further support.
Accessibility Note - For those using screen readers, on the below FAQ's please select the '>>' widget next to the section title to unhide the text so it becomes visible to the screen reader.
Cambridge C1 Advanced (CAE)
In order to verify the Cambridge Advanced (or CAE) online, applicants need to supply their "secret number".
Band A
Overall score: 180 - No component below 170
Band B
Overall score: 190 - 2 at 170, 2 at 190
Band C
Overall score: 200 - 2 at 180, 2 at 200
Band D
Overall score: 210 - 2 at 190, 2 at 210
Cambridge C2 Proficiency (CPE)
The following CPE results are required for each English Language band:
Band A
180 overall; no component below 170
Band B
190 overall; 2 at 170, 2 at 190
Band C
200 overall; 2 at 180, 2 at 200
Band D
210 overall; 2 at 190, 2 at 210
Duolingo
The following Duolingo results are required for each English language band. Only Duolingo tests that provide individual Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening component scores are acceptable to meet English language conditions.
Band A
120 overall with at least 110 in each component (Speaking, Listening, Reading and Writing)
Band B
130 overall with at least 110 in two components and 130 in two components (Speaking, Listening, Reading and Writing)
Band C
140 overall with at least 120 in two components and 140 in two components (Speaking, Listening, Reading and Writing)
Please note: Applicants must share their Duolingo results directly with University of Warwick Postgraduate Admissions Service via their Duolingo dashboard. Uploading a PDF or screenshot of the results to the Applicant Portal will not be accepted.
International English Language Testing System (IELTS) (Academic, UKVI or IELTS Online)
The following IELTS (Academic, UKVI or IELTS Online) results are required for each English Language band. Note we do not accept one skill retakes. The test must be taken in one sitting.
Band A
6.5, none below 6.0
Band B
7.0, two at 6.0/6.5 & rest 7.0+
Band C
7.5, two at 6.5/7.0 & rest 7.5+
Band D
8.0, two at 7.0/7.5 & rest 8.0+
Pearson Test of English PTE (Academic) and PTE Academic UKVI
The Pearson (Academic) results below are required for each English Language band. Please note, PTE Academic Online is no longer accepted to meet English language conditions. Pearson (Academic) tests should be taken in a PTE Test Centre.
Band A
62 (including 59 + in all components)
Band B
70 (including 59 + in all components)
Band C
75 (including 59 + in all components)
Band D
79 (including 70 + in all components)
Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) (iBT) and TOEFL (iBT) Special Home Edition for tests taken before 21st January 2026
The following TOEFL (iBT) test results are required for each English language band:
Band A
92, comprising Reading 22, Listening 21, Speaking 23, Writing 21
Band B
100, comprising Reading 22, Listening 21, Speaking 23, Writing 21
Band C
108, none below 23
Band D
113, none below 25
The University of Warwick only accepts TOEFL (iBT) scores from the single most recent test date, not MyBest scores. Please note we only accept the test at a test centre or at home. We do not accept the test on paper.
Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) (iBT) and TOEFL (iBT) Special Home Edition for tests taken on or after 21st January 2026
The following TOEFL (iBT) test results are required for each English language band:
Band A
Total Score 4.5 including minimum of 4.5 in each component
Band B
Total Score 5.0 including minimum of 4.5 in each component
Band C
Total Score 5.5 including minimum of 5.0 in each component
Note: iBT or IBT Home Edition. Tests taken on or after 21 January 2026 are acceptable for courses starting after this date. MyBest scores will not be accepted. All components on a single test date must meet the required level.
Trinity Integrated Skills in English (ISE) II
The following Trinity ISE II test results are required for each English language band:
Band A
Distinction Distinction Merit Merit in four components
Band B, C and D
Not Acceptable
Trinity Integrated Skills in English (ISE) III
The following Trinity ISE III test results are required for each English language band:
Band A
Pass Pass Pass Pass in four components
Band B
Merit Merit Pass Pass in four components
Band C
Distinction Distinction Merit Merit in four components
Band D
Not acceptable
Trinity Integrated Skills in English (ISE) IV
The following Trinity ISE IV test results are required for each English language band:
Band A, B, C, D
Pass Pass Pass Pass in four components
Application deadlines
If you do not require a student visa there are no application deadlines for most of our postgraduate taught courses.
If you require a student visa, the application deadline for all courses starting in September/October 2026 is 2 August 2026.
However, places are limited in some departments so you should submit your application as soon as possible. Some departments also have earlier deadlines – so you should check the information in the Essential Information for each course.
Our course band requirements
You can find the English language band requirements for the course you are interested in, on our Postgraduate course pages.
Look for the Language Requirements header under the Entry Requirements tab on each course page for more in-depth information.
